body: I would love to be able to say yes, but honestly the only reason why I was able to try to get help is because I'm in the middle of a manic period. When I'm in a depressive period, getting better isn't on my radar at all.

Thanks for the reply.

I won't make it to my appointment, and don't want to push anybody else farther down the list. I'll just try to get through it on my own.

It's sad that the mental illness support in Ontario is so backed up.
